# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Argentina 1970 national programme. Generated by tools/argentina_1970/compile.py.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = ARG }
				ARG = {
					COLDWAR_ARG_initialize = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_history = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_treaties = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = ARG }
				ARG = {
					COLDWAR_ARG_initialize = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_history = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_treaties = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = ARG }
				ARG = {
					COLDWAR_ARG_initialize = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_history = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_treaties = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = ARG }
				ARG = {
					COLDWAR_ARG_initialize = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_history = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_treaties = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_peaceconference_ended = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = ARG }
				ARG = {
					COLDWAR_ARG_initialize = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_history = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
					COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_treaties = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
					NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_world_refresh_done }
				}
				set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_ARG_world_refresh_done days = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { country_exists = ARG }
					ARG = { COLDWAR_ARG_daily = yes }
				}
				COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_treaties = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
